Umbra primei soții

Adele Parks, Andrei Covaciu (Translator)

3.90
21,318 ratings1,703 reviews
Rate this book
Ai 47 de ani, o minte sclipitoare de om de știință și milioane în cont. Crezi că ești mult prea inteligentă și calculată ca să fii vreodată manipulată? Fix pe siguranța asta se bazează și el.

Când Emma îl întâlnește pe Matthew, vede doar un văduv îndurerat care are nevoie de căldură și sprijin. Ea nu știe că are în față un altfel de prădător – cel care te cucerește prin doliu și vulnerabilitate, nu prin amenințări.

Matthew este genul care te cere de nevastă plin de săpun în duș și, fără să realizezi când sau cum, te face să-ți ceri scuze pentru că ai bani și succes, în timp ce el se instalează confortabil în viața ta.

Ceea ce urmează pare desprins dintr-un vârtej romantic: o cerere în căsătorie după doar trei luni și o fugă secretă în Maldive, departe de ochii lumii.

About the author

Adele Parks

95 books3,734 followers


Adele Parks MBE is one of the most-loved and biggest-selling women's fiction writers in the UK. She has sold over 4 million books and her work has been translated into 30 different languages.

She has published 21 novels, all of which have been London Times bestsellers.

Adele has written 19 contemporary novels and 2 historical ones, Spare Brides and If You Go Away, which are set during and after WW1. Her latest novels, Both of You, Just My Luck, Lies Lies Lies, I Invited Her In, The Image of You and The Stranger in My Home are twisty, domestic noirs. Adele likes to scrutinize our concepts of family, our theories on love, parenting and fidelity.

During her career Adele has lived in Italy, Botswana and London. Now she lives happily in Surrey, UK with her husband, son and cat.

If you want to stay in touch you can find Adele on Twitter @AdeleParks, Instagram @Adele_Parks or Facebook @OfficialAdeleParks. You can sign up to her newsletter at eepurl.com/cI0l and there’s lots more info about Adele and her books on www.adeleparks.com.

Emma may be Matthew’s second wife…but is he really ready to move on from his first?
Emma has been a loner most her life. She’s worked hard and established a very successful career. Money is no issue. Sadly, she neglected to make time for love and starting a family.

But sometimes love finds you when you least expect it.

At a conference Emma runs into a handsome, younger man named Matthew. Though recently widowed, he confides with Emma that he feels ready to once again jump into love.

Emma is smitten! Things are moving quickly but she doesn’t care! She can’t pass up this opportunity, thinking she may never have another. But her two best friends aren’t exactly on-board. They believe Matthew isn’t at all what he presents himself to be, and have questions.

Is he in this for the right reasons? Why is he always comparing Emma to his first wife? Will Emma be willing to take a deep breath and look at truly what’s in front of her? Because it’s not all adding up!

How do you recognize a red flag? Well, let’s see, how about…
🚩 The fact you’ve never seen his home yet, while he practically lives at yours?
🚩You’ve never met his family or friends.
🚩 You continue to feel a distant second to his first wife who passed away a year ago?
🚩Your best friends don’t trust him.

Girl!? How many red flags do you need to know this is not going to work!? Well, of course she didn’t listen to me and after three months, and against the better judgment of her besties (and me) she jumped into marrying him!

Is there a happily ever after in Emma’s future? You know the drill…you’ll just have to read this book to find out!

WITHOUT A SHADOW OF A DOUBT......
"First Wife's Shadow" is one of my "besties" of 2024.

Kudos to author Adele Parks for penning a compelling, beguiling, gripping, and whip-smart tale of love, friendship, obsession, betrayal, and revenge.

The book begins with a Rebecca vibe.

Norma ~ The Sisters

April 2, 2025
Gripping, unpredictable, and chilling!

First Wife’s Shadow by Adele Parks had me hooked from the very first page. It’s a fantastic example of psychological tension, pulling you deeper into Emma’s paranoia (or is it reality?) with every chapter. The story is a slow burn, steadily building an unsettling sense of unease until it all comes together in a brilliantly clever finale.

Emma’s descent into obsession is captivating. Her uncertainty about Matthew, her insecurities about his late wife, and the eerie sense that something is very wrong all build toward a suspenseful, edge-of-your-seat experience. Is she losing her mind? Is Matthew manipulating her? Or is there something even more sinister at play?

And that ending? Absolutely brilliant. So clever, so satisfying—I did not see it coming. It’s the kind of conclusion that makes me want to go back and pick up on all the little clues that I missed.

There’s something about Adele Parks’ writing that is extremely compelling and immersive. She knows exactly how to draw you in and keep you questioning everything.

This was another enjoyable sister read that I read with my IRL sister, Brenda.

A must-read for domestic thriller lovers!

*Mental Torture*

This one made me question a lot of things. This is in regard to meeting new people especially those of a romantic kind….

This book drew me in from the start. There were alarm bells going off in my head but I guess I can be cynical at times. There main character Emma is a successful businesswomen who is disciplined and she has worked hard to create her own fortune. She has built her house out in the woods that is secluded but has a lot of glass. Her closest friends have a key to her home and she has built the life that she feels is idyllic.

One day she meets Matthew who is eleven years her junior, her one concern is at 47 she feels it is unlikely that she will be able to have children if the relationship blossoms.

Emma’s world is about to change drastically. After a very short period of time she is falling for Matthew and he appears to feel the same. The one drawback is that he was married before and with the death of his wife only a year ago, the relationship feels like she is walking in his dead wife’s shadow.

There will come a time when Emma wishes that her only problem was their age gap. Things are starting to happen that make her second guess herself. But, worse is to come and motives soon become clear that someone is lying. There are a few twists but the ending is not what I expected but satisfying. I went from disliking some of the characters to changing my mind as several pennies started to drop.

I found it hard to stop reading, this book was engaging and a great psychological thriller.

Spoilers!!!




Uh, no! No, no, no, no, no! How can this plot, on any level, be believable?

Smart, driven heroine is scammed by sleazy couple for her money. Heroine loses all her common sense and logic and marries stranger after 3 month relationship, even if her besties tell her she’s crazy. Strange events start to happen in heroine’s house. She thinks it’s hubs’ dead wife causing havoc. Almost right. Dead wife isn’t dead. Heroine almost dies when someone messes with the brakes in her car. She hits and kills someone. Cops sort it out. Hubs gets off because his partner was the planner of the scheme, and he supposedly didn’t mess with brakes (but really, he did). Heroine divorces sleeze bag hubs snd gives him a lot of her hard-earned money even though he was scamming her. Then she visits sleeze girl in prison, and they become besties. Sleaze girl serves her time and heroine finds out that they are actually half sisters. Heroine’s friends take scammer girl into their friendship circle, and they will all live happily ever after.

Sorry. This is so far off from logic and the real world that it’s laughable.

I do feel bad for the author. She tried. But, it got published and appears to be selling well, so I guess no sympathy is needed.

Bottom line, I thought the book was terrible. I won’t be reading any more books by this author!

Emma has overcome a deeply traumatic childhood: after losing her alcoholic parents in a car crash, she and her brother were raised by indifferent, wealthy grandparents who packed them both off to separate boarding schools.
Determined to build a life of her own, Emma has worked tirelessly for her success. Now a thriving CEO with a stunning eco-friendly home and plenty of money in the bank, she crosses paths at a conference with Matthew, a freelance photographer who shares that his wife, Becky, recently died in a workplace accident.
Their connection quickly deepens into romance, moving at breakneck speed as Matthew moves in with Emma and proposes. Steering her away from marrying in her childhood church, he persuades her to elope for a tiny ceremony overseas. With everything escalating so rapidly, Emma’s two best friends, Heidi and Gina, harbour serious doubts about Matthew—yet Emma remains completely swept up in him.
Before long, Emma finds herself thinking more and more about Matthew’s late wife—just as unsettling things begin happening around the house, from the heating cranking up on its own to smashed pots. It couldn’t possibly be Becky, because she’s dead… so who is behind it all?

Książki Adele Parks czytam od lat (naprawdę - z 20 lat minęło!), jednak z taką jej powieściową petardą nie miałam jeszcze do czynienia!

Przewracałam oczami, zgrzytałam zębami z frustracji, wstrzymywałam oddech na ostatnich stronach - mieszanka emocji, które towarzyszyły mi podczas lektury była dość różnorodna. Przede wszystkim jednak - kapitalnie się bawiłam!

Zacznijmy od tego, że Parks wie, jak napisać historię, którą wciągasz jak dobry serial na Netfliksie. Główna bohaterka - Emma - jest zakochana, pełna nadziei, trochę (bardzo) naiwna i wchodzi w małżeństwo z mężczyzną, którego cień byłej żony nie odstępuje na krok. Była żona w tej historii nie gra drugoplanowej roli. O nie! Jest raczej jak duch, unoszący się nad każdym aspektem życia Emily i jej męża. Tylko teoretycznie jest "byłą", a wspomnienia Matthew i jego tajemnice sprawiają, że zaczynasz się zastanawiać: co tu się właściwie dzieje?! Komu zaufać?!

Powieść Parks wypełniona jest mocarnymi plot twistami, ale też subtelną grą tajemnic i psychologicznych zawiłości, które trzymają w napięciu do samego finału!
Wciąga, intryguje, zostaje w głowie na długo! Nie zastanawiać się - czytać!
